import copy
import math
import unittest

import solution


class ExportModelTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_and_normal_export(self):
        self.assertEqual(solution.export_model([]), "MODEL 1\n")
        objects = [
            {"name": "first", "vertices": [(1, 2.5, -3), (1.234567, 0, 10)]},
            {"name": "empty", "vertices": []},
        ]
        expected = (
            "MODEL 1\n"
            "OBJECT first 2\n"
            "V 1 2.5 -3\n"
            "V 1.23457 0 10\n"
            "OBJECT empty 0\n"
        )
        self.assertEqual(solution.export_model(objects), expected)

    def test_offsets_are_optional_and_applied_before_scale(self):
        objects = [{"name": "shifted", "vertices": [(1, 2, 3)], "offset": (4, -2, 0.5)}]
        self.assertEqual(
            solution.export_model(objects, scale=2, apply_offsets=True),
            "MODEL 1\nOBJECT shifted 1\nV 10 0 7\n",
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            solution.export_model(objects, scale=2, apply_offsets=False),
            "MODEL 1\nOBJECT shifted 1\nV 2 4 6\n",
        )

    def test_inputs_are_not_mutated(self):
        objects = [{"name": "a", "vertices": [[1, 2, 3]], "offset": [4, 5, 6]}]
        before = copy.deepcopy(objects)
        solution.export_model(objects, scale=0.5, apply_offsets=True)
        self.assertEqual(objects, before)

    def test_container_and_scalar_type_errors(self):
        bad_calls = [
            lambda: solution.export_model(()),
            lambda: solution.export_model([[]]),
            lambda: solution.export_model([{"name": 1, "vertices": []}]),
            lambda: solution.export_model([{"name": "a", "vertices": ()}]),
            lambda: solution.export_model([{"name": "a", "vertices": [(1, True, 3)]}]),
            lambda: solution.export_model([{"name": "a", "vertices": [], "offset": (0, "x", 0)}]),
            lambda: solution.export_model([], scale=True),
            lambda: solution.export_model([], apply_offsets=1),
        ]
        for call in bad_calls:
            with self.subTest(call=call):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    call()

    def test_value_and_shape_errors(self):
        bad_calls = [
            lambda: solution.export_model([{"name": "", "vertices": []}]),
            lambda: solution.export_model([{"name": "a\nb", "vertices": []}]),
            lambda: solution.export_model([{"name": "a", "vertices": [(1, 2)]}]),
            lambda: solution.export_model([{"name": "a", "vertices": [(1, math.inf, 3)]}]),
            lambda: solution.export_model([{"name": "a", "vertices": [], "offset": (1, 2)}]),
            lambda: solution.export_model([], scale=0),
            lambda: solution.export_model([], scale=-1),
            lambda: solution.export_model([], scale=math.nan),
        ]
        for call in bad_calls:
            with self.subTest(call=call):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    call()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
